snap_y.brief: 把设备 y 吸附到 1/64 像素栅格 / Snap a device y to a 1/64 px grid

params.y: in:设备 y 坐标 / Device y coordinate

snap_y.return: 吸附后的 y / The snapped y
snap_y.note: 布局会累积浮点误差，1/64 的倍数可精确表示，因此平移后的行与重绘的行总能一致 / Layout accumulates fractional error; multiples of 1/64 are exactly representable so a shifted copy of a row and a repainted row always agree

ctx_dev_y.brief: 把文档 y 映射为设备 y / Map a document y to device y

params.scroll: in:纵向滚动偏移 / Vertical scroll offset

ctx_dev_y.note: 映射关系为 `doc_y - scroll + dev_y` / The mapping is `doc_y - scroll + dev_y`

box_device_rect.brief: 求盒边框盒的设备矩形 / Device rect of a box's border box

params.scroll: in:纵向滚动偏移 / Vertical scroll offset

box_device_rect.return: 设备坐标矩形，y 已吸附 / Device-space rect with y snapped

is_list_item.brief: 判断盒是否为 `ul`/`ol` 下的 `<li>` / Test whether a box is an `<li>` inside a `ul`/`ol`
is_list_item.return: 是列表项返回 1，否则 0 / 1 for a list item, else 0

list_index.brief: 求 `<li>` 在其 `<ol>` 中的序号 / 1-based position of an `<li>` among its `<ol>` siblings

params.box: in:列表项盒 / List item box

list_index.return: 之前的 `<li>` 兄弟个数（0 起）/ Number of preceding `<li>` siblings, zero based
list_index.note: 父级不是 `<ol>` 时返回 0 / Returns 0 when the parent is not an `<ol>`

effective_list_type.brief: 求实际生效的 list-style-type / Effective `list-style-type` for a list item

params.box: in:列表项盒 / List item box

effective_list_type.return: 生效的列表标记类型 / The effective list marker type
effective_list_type.note: 盒树只继承固定的属性列表，项自身未声明时从父盒读取 / The box tree inherits only a fixed property list, so the value is read from the parent when the item declares none

paint_marker_square.brief: 绘制方形列表标记 / Paint a square list marker

params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.box: in:列表项盒 / List item box
params.marker_x: in:标记锚点 X / Marker anchor X
params.baseline: in:基线设备 y / Baseline device y

paint_marker_square.note: 对应 `list-style-type: square`，尺寸取字号的 0.32 / Corresponds to `list-style-type: square` with a size of 0.32 times the font size

paint_marker_circle.brief: 绘制空心圆列表标记 / Paint a hollow circle list marker

params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.box: in:列表项盒 / List item box
params.marker_x: in:标记锚点 X / Marker anchor X
params.baseline: in:基线设备 y / Baseline device y

paint_marker_circle.note: 对应 `list-style-type: circle` / Corresponds to `list-style-type: circle`

paint_list_marker.brief: 绘制列表项的标记 / Paint a list item's marker

params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.box: in:列表项盒 / List item box
params.scroll: in:纵向滚动偏移 / Vertical scroll offset

paint_list_marker.note: 支持 decimal、square、circle、disc；`list-style-type:none` 与非列表项直接返回 / Supports decimal, square, circle and disc; returns immediately for `list-style-type:none` and non-list boxes

paint_text_decorations.brief: 绘制文本装饰线 / Paint text decoration lines

params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.box: in:含文本行的盒 / Box holding the text lines
params.scroll: in:纵向滚动偏移 / Vertical scroll offset
params.dec: in:装饰位掩码 / Decoration bit mask

paint_text_decorations.note: 下划线、上划线、删除线各画一条 1px 线，覆盖行内非原子 run 的水平范围 / Draws one 1px line each for underline, overline and line-through spanning the horizontal extent of the line's non-atomic runs

paint_box_shadow.brief: 绘制盒的 box-shadow / Paint a box's `box-shadow`

params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.bb: in:盒的设备矩形 / Device rect of the box

paint_box_shadow.note: 阴影矩形由偏移与 spread 从 bb 推出，无效或全透明时跳过 / The shadow rect is derived from `bb` by the offset and spread; skipped when invalid or fully transparent

paint_text_shadow.brief: 绘制文本的 text-shadow / Paint a box's `text-shadow`

params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.box: in:含文本行的盒 / Box holding the text lines
params.scroll: in:纵向滚动偏移 / Vertical scroll offset

paint_text_shadow.note: 逐个非原子 run 按阴影偏移绘制字形掩码 / Draws the glyph mask of every non-atomic run offset by the shadow

paint_background.brief: 绘制盒背景 / Paint a box's background

params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.bb: in:盒的设备矩形 / Device rect of the box

paint_background.note: 线性渐变背景优先；否则纯色填充，radius > 0.5 时走圆角填充 / A linear-gradient background wins; otherwise a solid fill, using the rounded-rect path when `radius > 0.5`

paint_borders.brief: 绘制四边边框 / Paint the four border bands

params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.bb: in:盒的设备矩形 / Device rect of the box

paint_borders.note: 有圆角时退化为单环并取最不透明的边框色；无有效边框时直接返回 / With rounded corners it collapses to a single ring using the most opaque border colour; returns early when no border is effective

group_clip_scratch.brief: 把离屏矩形夹紧到目标裁剪区 / Clamp a scratch rect to the destination clip

params.pm: in:目标像素缓冲 / Destination pixel buffer
params.x0: inout:离屏左边界，被夹紧 / Scratch left edge, clamped in place
params.y0: inout:离屏上边界，被夹紧 / Scratch top edge, clamped in place
params.w: inout:离屏宽度，被夹紧 / Scratch width, clamped in place
params.h: inout:离屏高度，被夹紧 / Scratch height, clamped in place

group_clip_scratch.return: 夹紧后仍非空返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when the clamped rect is still non-empty, else 0

group_composite.brief: 把离屏子树结果合成回目标 / Composite a scratch subtree result back onto the destination

params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Destination pixel buffer
params.scratch: in:承载子树的离屏缓冲 / Scratch buffer holding the subtree
params.x0: in:离屏左边界 / Scratch left edge
params.y0: in:离屏上边界 / Scratch top edge
params.xf: in:变换矩阵，可为 `NULL` / Transform matrix, may be `NULL`
params.anchor_x: in:变换锚点 X / Transform anchor X
params.anchor_y: in:变换锚点 Y / Transform anchor Y

group_composite.note: 有变换时把目标像素逆映射回离屏空间；源 alpha 乘以 opacity 后按 255 定点混合 / With a transform each destination pixel is inverse-mapped into scratch space; source alpha is scaled by `opacity` and blended in 255 fixed point

paint_group.brief: 把盒子树绘入离屏缓冲再按不透明度合成回来 / Paint a box's subtree into a scratch pixmap and blend it back with an opacity

params.ctx: in:上层绘制上下文 / Enclosing paint context
params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Destination pixel buffer
params.box: in:分组根盒 / Group root box
params.scroll: in:纵向滚动偏移 / Vertical scroll offset
params.bbox: in:要捕获的设备区域 / Device-space region to capture
params.opacity: in:整组不透明度 0..1 / Group opacity in 0..1
params.xf: in:变换矩阵，可为 `NULL` / Transform matrix, may be `NULL`
params.anchor_x: in:变换锚点 X / Transform anchor X
params.anchor_y: in:变换锚点 Y / Transform anchor Y

paint_group.note: 先在离屏内孤立合成子树，避免子盒与不应见到的兄弟混合、也避免把整组不透明度逐个泄漏给后代；仅应用变换时 opacity 为 1.0 / The subtree is composited in isolation first so a child cannot blend with a sibling it should never see and the group opacity is not leaked into each descendant; `opacity` is 1.0 when only a transform is applied

transform_bounds.brief: 求变换后盒的轴对齐包围盒 / Axis-aligned bounds of a transformed box

params.bb: in:变换前的盒矩形 / Box rect before the transform

transform_bounds.return: 变换后四角的轴对齐包围盒 / Axis-aligned bounds of the four transformed corners
transform_bounds.note: 恒等变换时原样返回；旋转/倾斜会把盒变成四边形 / Returns the input unchanged for an identity transform; rotate and skew turn the box into a quad

paint_box.brief: 绘制一个盒及其子树 / Paint a box and its subtree

params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.box: in:待绘制的盒 / Box to paint
params.scroll: in:纵向滚动偏移 / Vertical scroll offset

paint_box.note: `display:none` 跳过；需要分组（透明度或变换）时走 paint_group，否则直接画内部 / `display:none` is skipped; a box needing a group (opacity or transform) goes through paint_group, otherwise its inner content is painted directly

paint_box_own_content.brief: 绘制盒自身的视觉内容 / Paint a box's own visuals

params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.own_scroll: in:本盒的滚动偏移 / The box's own scroll offset
params.bb: in:盒的设备矩形 / Device rect of the box
params.radius: in:圆角半径，负值表示百分比 / Corner radius, negative meaning a percentage

paint_box_own_content.note: 依次绘制阴影、背景、边框、列表标记、文本阴影、文本 run 与装饰；原子行内 run 由子盒递归绘制 / Paints the shadow, background, borders, list marker, text shadow, text runs and decorations; atomic inline runs are painted via child recursion

stacked_insert_sorted.brief: 按 z-index 升序插入分层盒序列 / Insert a box into the z-order stack by ascending z-index

params.stacked: inout:分层盒指针数组 / Stacked box pointer array
params.n: in:数组当前长度 / Current array length

stacked_insert_sorted.note: 对末尾元素做插入排序；长度不足 2 时无操作 / Insertion sort on the last element; no-op when the length is below 2

paint_box_children.brief: 绘制子盒子树 / Paint the child subtree

params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.scroll: in:纵向滚动偏移 / Vertical scroll offset

paint_box_children.note: 静态子盒按顺序绘制，定位子盒按 z-index 升序叠在上层 / Static children paint in order; positioned children paint on top in ascending z-index

paint_box_clipped_children.brief: 按 overflow 裁剪后绘制子盒 / Paint the children clipped per `overflow`

params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.scroll: in:纵向滚动偏移 / Vertical scroll offset
params.own_scroll: in:本盒的滚动偏移 / The box's own scroll offset

paint_box_clipped_children.note: hidden/scroll/auto 会为子树建立裁剪矩形；元素级滚动尚未实现，scroll/auto 对超出内容表现为 hidden / `hidden`/`scroll`/`auto` establish a clip rect; element-level scrolling is not modelled, so `scroll`/`auto` behave like `hidden` for overflow

paint_box_inner.brief: 绘制盒自身内容与已裁剪的子盒 / Paint a box's own content and its clipped children

params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.scroll: in:纵向滚动偏移 / Vertical scroll offset

paint_box_inner.note: 固定定位盒不随滚动，其子树同样使用零滚动；`visibility:hidden` 只隐藏本盒自身视觉，子树仍递归 / Fixed boxes never scroll and their subtrees share the same zero offset; `visibility:hidden` hides only this box's own visuals while the subtree is still recursed

hpe_paint_document.brief: 绘制整个文档 / Paint the whole document

params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.root: in:盒子树根，可为 `NULL` / Box tree root, may be `NULL`
params.scroll_y: in:纵向滚动偏移 / Vertical scroll offset
params.page_background: in:页面背景色 / Page background colour
params.origin_y: in:页面视口顶边的设备 y / Device y of the page viewport's top edge

hpe_paint_document.note: 先用背景色清屏，再把内容裁剪在 [origin_y, 像素缓冲高) 之内，避免画到浏览器外框上 / Clears with the background colour first, then clips content to `[origin_y, pixmap height)` so it never paints over browser chrome

hpe_paint_region.brief: 只重绘裁剪区域内的文档 / Repaint only the document inside a clip region

params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.root: in:盒子树根，可为 `NULL` / Box tree root, may be `NULL`
params.scroll_y: in:纵向滚动偏移 / Vertical scroll offset
params.page_background: in:页面背景色 / Page background colour
params.clip: in:设备坐标下的裁剪矩形 / Clip rect in device coordinates
params.origin_y: in:页面视口顶边的设备 y / Device y of the page viewport's top edge

hpe_paint_region.note: 供滚动损伤跟踪使用：只用背景色擦除 clip，再重绘与该区域相交的文档；clip 会被抬到 origin_y 之下 / Used by scroll damage tracking: erases only `clip` with the background, then repaints the document intersected with it; the clip is raised below `origin_y`
